gui.exerion.guidebook.title: Exerion Guidebook
gui.exerion.guide.intro.welcome: Welcome to the Exerion Industrial Guide!
gui.exerion.guide.intro.desc1: Use the side tabs to navigate between eras.
gui.exerion.guide.intro.step1: 1. Gather the required items for your current Era.
gui.exerion.guide.intro.step2: 2. Insert them into the Progression Terminal.
gui.exerion.guide.intro.sandbox: Sandbox: Machines are free to use once unlocked!
gui.exerion.guide.iron.gear_press.desc: Presses ingots into plates and gears. Requires mechanical rotational force (from a Hand Crank, Water Wheel, or Steam Engine) applied to its shaft. The pressure will double the efficiency of plate production compared to a crafting table.
gui.exerion.guide.iron.crusher.desc: Crushes ores to double your resources. Like the Gear Press, it requires rotational force. It has a 25% chance to output extra dust. Keep it well-powered for continuous operation.
gui.exerion.guide.mech.wrench.desc: Used to rotate blocks and safely remove machines. Shift-Right-Clicking a machine will dismantle it instantly and keep its internal inventory intact. A must-have tool for factory builders.
gui.exerion.guide.steel.boiler.desc: Boils water to produce high-pressure Steam Crystals. You must supply it with Water (via buckets or pumps) and a solid fuel source like Coal. Warning: Running without water while heated will cause an explosion!
gui.exerion.guide.steel.turbine.desc: Consumes Steam Crystals to generate raw mechanical force and EU (Electrical Units) simultaneously. Place it next to a Boiler to automate crystal insertion. The faster it spins, the more energy it yields.
gui.exerion.guide.ind.generator.desc: A basic solid-fuel generator. Burns coal, wood, or other fuels to produce 10 EU/t. It has an internal buffer of 4,000 EU. Connect Copper Cables to its output face to power nearby machines.
gui.exerion.guide.ind.elec_crusher.desc: An upgraded, electrified version of the Manual Crusher. Processes items 5x faster and can be overclocked with Speed Upgrades. Consumes 2 EU/t per operation.
gui.exerion.guide.adv.solar.desc: Generates clean, renewable energy during the daytime. Must have a clear line of sight to the sky. Produces 10 EU/t and is completely silent. Cannot operate during thunderstorms.
gui.exerion.guide.stone.raw.desc: Mined deep underground. This raw mineral hums with latent energy. It forms the foundation of all Exerion technologies.
gui.exerion.guide.stone.core.desc: Crafted from raw exerion. This core acts as the beating heart for early machines and progression terminals.
gui.exerion.guide.copper.gear.desc: A basic mechanical component. Copper's malleability makes it easy to shape into gears, but it wears out quickly under high stress.
gui.exerion.guide.copper.water_wheel.des: Harnesses the flow of water to generate early kinetic energy. Essential for powering basic mechanical presses before steam is unlocked.
gui.exerion.guide.mech.shaft.desc: Transfers rotational force in a straight line. Essential for connecting your water wheels and hand cranks to gear presses and crushers.
gui.exerion.guide.dig.logic.desc: The brain of digital machinery. Required for complex processing, storage terminals, and automated routing.
gui.exerion.guide.dig.terminal.desc: The central hub for tracking your technological evolution. Submit resources here to advance your civilization's era.
gui.exerion.guide.quant.chest.desc: Transmits items across dimensions instantly using quantum entanglement on specific frequency bands.
gui.exerion.guide.cosm.laser.desc: A cosmic-level excavation tool. Obliterates massive areas of terrain in seconds but consumes astronomical amounts of energy.
